changelog:
senseaudio-pronunciation-coach v1.0.0

- Initial release of the pronunciation coaching tool for foreign language learners
- Allows users to listen to standard TTS, record themselves, and receive word-by-word feedback
- Offers practice material via direct input, preset scenes, or targeted phoneme drills
- Analyzes recordings to diagnose specific phoneme issues, with tailored drills and accuracy tracking
- Tracks progress and provides visual summaries of pronunciation weaknesses over multiple sessions
summary: Foreign language pronunciation coach — listen to standard TTS pronunciation, record yourself, get word-by-word feedback on what was wrong, then practice targ...
